```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Попробуем с выбросами

```{r}
sleep |> filter(NAME %in% outliers.log.NAME) |> datatable(options = list(scrollX=T))
```

```{r}
model.full <- lm(LIFESPAN.log ~ . - NAME, sleep.reg, na.action=na.omit)
model.full.beta <- model.full |> lm.beta()
model.full.beta |> summary()
```

```{r}
model.excl <- lm(LIFESPAN.log ~ . - NAME - GESTTIME.log, sleep.reg, na.action=na.omit)
model.excl.beta <- model.excl |> lm.beta()
model.excl.beta |> summary()
```

```{r}
confidenceEllipse(model.full.beta, 
                  which.coef = c("BRAIN_WEIGHT.log", "SLEEP"),
                  levels = c(0.95),
                  col = c("steelblue"),
                  ylim=c(0,0.55),
                  xlim=c(0,1.2))
```

```{r}
model.tiny <- lm(LIFESPAN.log ~ BRAIN_WEIGHT.log, sleep.reg, na.action=na.omit)
model.tiny.beta <- model.tiny |> lm.beta()
model.tiny.beta |> summary()
```
